matchGroups: 食品|买菜|运输|送货|成本|价格|food|grocer|deliver|transport|cost|price

text.zh-Hans: 油价上涨不只影响加油：燃油变贵会推高运输成本，能源和化肥成本也会进入食品生产，因而买菜和送货都可能变贵。
text.en: Oil affects more than the fuel bill: dearer fuel raises transport costs, while energy and fertilizer costs enter food production. Groceries and deliveries can therefore become more expensive.

text.zh-Hans: 食品经过生产和运输才到家庭；这些环节的投入成本上升，可能逐步传到零售价。
text.en: Food reaches households through production and transport; higher input costs can gradually reach retail prices.

text.zh-Hans: 传递不一定即时或等比例：补贴、存货和当地供需条件会改变家庭实际承受的涨幅。
text.en: Pass-through need not be immediate or proportional: subsidies, inventories and local supply and demand affect what households actually pay.

impact.zh-Hans: 先分开看加油、食物和配送支出，才能辨认压力来自哪一环。
impact.en: Separate fuel, food and delivery spending to identify the channel affecting you.

zh-Hans: 对照同一时期的燃油、食品和配送账单，不把全部涨价都归因于石油。
如要估计本地涨幅，再查当地价格篮子、补贴及运输成本资料。
en: Compare fuel, food and delivery bills for the same period; do not attribute every price rise to oil.
For local magnitudes, obtain the relevant price basket, subsidy and transport-cost data.

boundary.zh-Hans: 这里解释传递机制，不预测当地物价或把石油与天然气当作同一种商品。
boundary.en: This explains channels, not local price forecasts; oil and natural gas are distinct commodities.

zh-Hans: 本地传递幅度、时滞和补贴覆盖尚未估计。
en: Local pass-through magnitude, timing and subsidy coverage are not estimated.

text.zh-Hans: GDP 增长表示全社会产出增加，不表示每个家庭工资都会增加。家庭是否更宽裕，要看自己的税后收入、收入分配和必要支出的价格。
text.en: GDP growth means greater total output, not a pay rise for every household. Whether a family is better off depends on its disposable income, distribution of gains and the prices of necessities.

text.zh-Hans: 平均工资可以在部分高收入者加薪时上升，其他人未必获得同样增幅；总量和平均数都不能代替你的工资。
text.en: Average wages can rise when gains are concentrated among higher earners; totals and averages do not describe your own pay.

text.zh-Hans: 即使名义收入增加，物价上涨也可能抵消购买力；还应区分税前工资与税后可用收入。
text.en: Even a nominal pay rise can be offset by prices. Gross wages must also be distinguished from disposable income.

impact.zh-Hans: 评估自己的生活改善，应看收入扣除必要支出后还剩多少，而不是只看 GDP 新闻。
impact.en: Judge your household position by what remains after necessary costs, rather than by GDP headlines alone.

zh-Hans: 对照同一时期的实得收入与食品、住房、交通支出。
看典型家庭时优先查收入中位数、实际可支配收入及其覆盖人群。
en: Compare take-home income and food, housing and transport costs over the same period.
For typical households, seek median and real disposable income with clear population coverage.

boundary.zh-Hans: 没有据此判断某个国家当年工资或每个家庭的实际变化。
boundary.en: No claim is made about wages in a particular country-year or every family.

zh-Hans: 具体国家、年份及家庭分组的收入与价格数据仍需另查。
en: Country-year and household-group income and price data must be queried separately.

matchGroups: 矿产|自然资源|资源丰富|mineral|natural resource|resource.rich
发展|就业|公共服务|贫|富|develop|job|public service|poor|wealth|rich

text.zh-Hans: 地下有资源不等于居民已经富裕。资源必须形成可获得的收入，再通过税收、公共投资和本地产业联系转化为就业与服务；这些环节失灵时，开采繁荣也可能没有带动多数家庭。
text.en: Resources underground do not automatically make residents prosperous. Revenues must be captured and converted into public investment and local economic links; extraction can expand without broad gains when those links fail.

text.zh-Hans: 收益如何征收、管理并投入教育、健康和基础设施，影响资源财富能否扩散到居民。
text.en: How rents are collected, managed and invested in health, education and infrastructure affects whether residents benefit.

text.zh-Hans: 只依赖开采还会暴露于商品价格起落；发展本地供应链和其他产业，是减少这种依赖的方向，并非保证成功。
text.en: Dependence on extraction exposes economies to commodity cycles. Local value chains and diversification can reduce reliance, without guaranteeing success.

impact.zh-Hans: 对家庭而言，出口收入新闻不等于本地岗位、学校或医疗已经改善。
impact.en: Export revenue headlines do not establish better local jobs, schools or health services.

zh-Hans: 查资源税收去了哪里，以及本地采购、就业和公共服务的实际变化。
再比较教育、基础设施和非开采产业投入，而不只比较矿产储量。
en: Trace resource revenue and observed local procurement, employment and services.
Compare investment in people, infrastructure and non-extractive sectors, not reserves alone.

boundary.zh-Hans: 依据非洲资源发展研究解释可能机制，不把资源丰富等同于腐败，也不诊断某个国家。
boundary.en: The Africa research illustrates possible channels; resource wealth does not establish corruption or diagnose a particular country.

zh-Hans: 特定国家的合同、财政、地方就业和服务数据尚未核对。
en: Country-specific contracts, fiscal flows, local jobs and services are not assessed.

text.zh-Hans: 先观察工作里的任务如何改变，而不是把使用 AI 等同于岗位消失。同一职业中，有些任务可被自动化，有些仍需人来判断、沟通或完成；岗位可能因此重组。
text.en: Watch changes in tasks before equating AI adoption with disappearing jobs. Some tasks can be automated while others still need people; a job can be reorganized rather than eliminated.

text.zh-Hans: 技术上可处理任务，不等于企业已经采用，也不等于实际裁员；技能、成本和基础设施会影响采用。
text.en: Technical task exposure is not actual adoption or observed layoffs; skills, costs and infrastructure affect implementation.

impact.zh-Hans: 你需要辨认哪些任务减少、哪些复核责任增加，以及岗位要求是否真的改变。
impact.en: Identify which tasks shrink, which review responsibilities grow, and whether actual job requirements change.

zh-Hans: 列出每周任务，标出可自动处理、需人工复核和必须现场完成的部分。
对照企业实际流程、培训和招聘要求，再选择一个具体技能补齐。
en: List weekly tasks and distinguish automation, human review and on-site work.
Check actual workflows, training and job requirements before choosing a specific skill to develop.

boundary.zh-Hans: 这是任务变化的分析方法，不预测你的岗位是否被裁，也不把暴露度当失业率。
boundary.en: This is a task-analysis method, not a layoff prediction; exposure is not an unemployment rate.

zh-Hans: 行业、岗位任务及企业实际采用和招聘变化尚待核对。
en: Sector, task mix and observed firm adoption and hiring must be checked.

matchGroups: 老年|老龄|人口.*年龄|older population|ageing|aging|retire
照护|护理|工作|劳动力|劳动供给|care|work|labou?r|econom

text.zh-Hans: 老年人口比重上升，会同时改变需要照护的人数与能够投入工作的时间和人力。养老金、医疗和长期照护需求可能增加；实际劳动力变化仍取决于健康、退休安排与劳动参与。
text.en: An older population changes care demand and the people and time available for work. Pension, health and long-term care needs can grow, while labour supply still depends on health, retirement and participation.

text.zh-Hans: 不能只按年龄判定不能工作；健康改善和更高参与可以缓解劳动力压力，但不会自动解决所有照护与财政问题。
text.en: Age alone does not establish inability to work. Better health and participation can ease labour pressures without automatically resolving care and fiscal needs.

impact.zh-Hans: 家庭应把照护安排和工作时间放在一起比较，而非只看人口总量。
impact.en: Compare care arrangements and work hours together, rather than relying on total population alone.

zh-Hans: 写出家庭照护时段、可用服务和谁能分担。
再核对工作弹性、照护服务可得性及当地劳动参与资料。
en: List care hours, available services and who can share responsibility.
Check flexible work, care-service availability and local participation data.

boundary.zh-Hans: 不同地区退休制度和健康状况不同，不能推出所有老龄社会都会衰退。
boundary.en: Retirement institutions and health differ; ageing does not establish inevitable decline everywhere.

zh-Hans: 本地年龄结构、劳动参与与照护服务能力仍需数据。
en: Local age structure, participation and care capacity require data.

text.zh-Hans: 工业选址要同时看水、电和物流，因为生产投入、设备运行和货物流通必须衔接；其中一个环节不可靠，都可能使整个生产安排受阻。
text.en: Industrial location depends on water, power and logistics together because production inputs, operating equipment and moving goods must connect. An unreliable link can interrupt the production plan.

text.zh-Hans: 水：要核对所需水量、水质、持续供应和排水条件；没有符合工艺要求的水源，低地价也未必可用。
text.en: Water: verify the quantity, quality, continuity and discharge arrangements required by the process; cheap land alone does not make a site usable.

text.zh-Hans: 电：要看供电容量和稳定性，而不只看标价；停电可能迫使产线停工。
text.en: Power: check capacity and reliability, not only the tariff; outages can halt production.

text.zh-Hans: 港口与物流：要看与供应商和客户的连接、运输时间及可靠性；港口延误会拖慢原料到达和产品交付。
text.en: Ports and logistics: assess connections to suppliers and customers, transit time and reliability; port delays can hold up inputs and deliveries.

impact.zh-Hans: 选址成本包含停工、延误和配套投入，不只是租金或土地价格。
impact.en: Site costs include interruption, delay and supporting infrastructure, not only rent or land prices.

zh-Hans: 按拟生产产品列出水、电和交付时间要求。
用各候选地的供应记录、接入条件和物流报价逐项比较。
en: List water, power and delivery-time needs for the proposed product.
Compare supply records, connection conditions and logistics quotes for each site.

boundary.zh-Hans: 这是可行性核对方法，不是具体厂址批准或投资建议。
boundary.en: This is a feasibility checklist, not site approval or an investment recommendation.

zh-Hans: 具体工艺、环境许可、水电记录和路线成本未核对。
en: Process needs, permits, utility records and route costs remain unchecked.

text.zh-Hans: 远方冲突可以通过商品供应和贸易路线传到本地：供应减少或航运受阻，会增加进口、生产和运输压力，再可能传到家庭支付的价格。
text.en: A distant conflict can reach local prices through commodity supply and trade routes: reduced supply or disrupted shipping can raise import, production and transport pressures that may reach households.

text.zh-Hans: 燃料和化肥变贵会影响食品生产，航线中断也会增加运输成本与延误；进口依赖较高的地方可能更敏感。
text.en: Dearer fuel and fertilizer affect food production, while shipping disruption adds costs and delays; import-dependent places can be more exposed.

impact.zh-Hans: 即使战事不在本国，食物、燃油和进口货物也可能受影响；不能把每次本地涨价都归因于战争。
impact.en: Food, fuel and imported goods can be affected without a domestic war; that does not make war the cause of every local price rise.

zh-Hans: 先查具体商品来自哪里、使用哪些路线，以及是否真的出现供应或运输中断。
再看本地价格、库存与补贴，区分已经发生的影响和风险情景。
en: Identify the commodity origin and routes, then verify an actual disruption.
Check local prices, inventories and subsidies; distinguish observed effects from scenarios.

boundary.zh-Hans: 引用历史机制和案例，不声称当前某航线已中断或某商品必定上涨。
boundary.en: Historical mechanisms and examples do not establish a current route closure or an inevitable price increase.

zh-Hans: 本次冲突、商品、航线与本地传递幅度未实时核验。
en: The specific conflict, commodity, route and local magnitude are not verified in real time.

text.zh-Hans: 不能用一个数字概括两国制造业。先确定比较的是经济中的比重、实际生产规模、就业、生产率还是产业构成；这些维度可能给出不同答案。
text.en: A single number cannot summarize two manufacturing sectors. First distinguish their economic share, production scale, employment, productivity and industry mix; these dimensions can give different answers.

text.zh-Hans: 制造业增加值占 GDP 比重与增加值总额不是同一个指标；比重较高不自动意味着规模更大。
text.en: Manufacturing value added as a share of GDP is not total manufacturing value added; a larger share does not automatically mean a larger sector.

text.zh-Hans: 比较实际差异时，要统一年份、制造业范围和价格口径；现价金额、实际增长和就业份额不能互相代替。
text.en: To establish actual differences, align year, manufacturing coverage and price basis; current-price levels, real growth and employment shares are not interchangeable.

impact.zh-Hans: 对职业或家庭计划，岗位类型、工资和地点往往比一个全国制造业总数更贴近你的问题。
impact.en: For work and household planning, job types, pay and location can be more relevant than a single national total.

zh-Hans: 先选一个要回答的比较维度，例如制造业比重或行业岗位。
再取马来西亚与越南同一年、同定义的数据；没有对齐前不排名。
en: Choose the relevant dimension, such as manufacturing share or industry jobs.
Obtain aligned Malaysia and Vietnam observations for the same year; do not rank before alignment.

boundary.zh-Hans: 已回答比较方法；此处未查询两国观测值，不宣称已证明实际排名或产业差异。
boundary.en: The comparison method is answered; country observations are not queried here, so actual rankings and industry differences remain unestablished.

zh-Hans: 两国对齐的数值、行业构成与就业工资资料尚未查询。
en: Aligned country values, industry composition, jobs and wages have not been queried.

matchGroups: 降息|利率|房贷|policy rate|rate cut|interest rate|mortgage
审批|资格|批准|拿到|申请|成本|付款|approval|eligib|qualif|obtain|loan|payment|cost|mortgage

text.zh-Hans: 降息可能降低新增或重新定价贷款的融资成本，但不等于每个人都更容易获批。贷款价格与能否通过银行审批，是两个需要分开核对的问题。
text.en: A rate cut can lower financing costs for new or repriced loans, but does not mean everyone can qualify. The price of credit and eligibility for credit must be checked separately.

text.zh-Hans: 固定利率合同在固定期内通常不会因政策利率变化而立即改变付款；具体变化取决于合同和重新定价时间。
text.en: A fixed-rate contract generally does not immediately change payments during its fixed period; the contract and repricing date matter.

text.zh-Hans: 审批还会考虑收入、现有债务、资产和信用记录；较低利率不能自动补足收入证明或消除其他风险。
text.en: Approval also considers income, existing debts, assets and credit history; a lower rate does not supply missing income evidence or remove other risks.

impact.zh-Hans: 先比较实际报价和付款，再单独核对申请资格，不用政策新闻推算自己的获批概率。
impact.en: Compare actual quotes and payments, then check eligibility separately; a policy headline is not your approval probability.

zh-Hans: 查合同是固定还是浮动、何时重定价，以及实际费用后的报价。
向拟申请机构核对收入、债务和信用资料要求，不把美国例子当本地规则。
en: Check fixed versus floating terms, repricing dates and fees in the actual offer.
Ask the intended lender for income, debt and credit requirements; US guidance is not local law.

boundary.zh-Hans: 依据英国传导说明与美国资格因素作一般解释；不提供马来西亚审批概率或个案金融结论。
boundary.en: UK transmission and US eligibility guidance support the distinction; no Malaysian approval probability or individual lending conclusion is supplied.

zh-Hans: 具体国家、产品、银行标准和个人资料未核对。
en: Country, product, lender standards and personal information remain unchecked.

matchGroups: 换工作|职业|工作选择|job change|career|changing jobs|change jobs|considering.*job

text.zh-Hans: 先把世界趋势与自己的可核实条件分开，再比较方向。行业变化是背景；你的实际岗位要求、实得收入、通勤、照护时间和缓冲资金，才是判断某个选择是否可行的条件。
text.en: Separate world trends from your own checkable conditions before comparing directions. Industry change is context; actual job requirements, take-home pay, commuting, care time and financial buffers determine whether an option fits.

text.zh-Hans: 宏观平均数不能替代个人收入与生活成本；AI 任务暴露也不能直接证明你的岗位将消失。
text.en: Macro averages do not replace personal income and costs, and AI task exposure does not establish that your own job will disappear.

impact.zh-Hans: 把每个方向的收益、代价和待核实条件写出来，保留由你作选择的空间。
impact.en: Write benefits, costs and unresolved conditions for each direction, leaving the choice to you.

zh-Hans: 在下方用合成或你自愿提供的资料比较两个方向，不自动保存。
选一个可观察条件，例如书面工时或实际通勤时间，事后复核。
en: Use the session below to compare two directions with synthetic or voluntarily supplied details; nothing is automatically saved.
Choose an observable condition, such as written hours or actual travel time, and review it later.

boundary.zh-Hans: 这是整理与比较方法，不替你决定职业，不把预期写成已经发生的结果。
boundary.en: This organizes a decision; it does not choose a career or turn expectations into observed outcomes.

zh-Hans: 你的实际条件与后续观察需要你明确提供和核实。
en: Your actual conditions and later observations require your explicit input and verification.
